resolution.note: ci wait mints the token for --repo; a policy 404 is absent only when the repository is readable; real run on seo-audit-harness PR 76 exits 0 in 7 s

title: krn ci wait recognises the adopted repository's ci / Check and reads base and head from that repository
body:
Why: Lead 2026-11-13 on krn-works/seo-audit-harness#76: from the KRN checkout it failed 'fatal: not a tree object'; from the pilot clone it exited 69 'gate never started' while ci / Check had passed.
Evidence: .krn/runs/state-review/decisions.md (state review 2026-11-13, Fable 5.2; data verified by the lead where noted), .krn/runs/state-review/portability-probe.md.
Source: operator 2026-11-13 ordered the state-review decisions executed ('lecisz z tym wszystkim').
